note: Three cook nights, then Charleston for Vansh & Kruti's wedding. Ingredient lists were written by Claude without reading the recipe pages, so check quantities on the recipe before you shop.

steps: Crumble the paneer. If it's store-bought, soak it in hot water while you start the masala.
Fry cumin, then onion and green chili until golden.
Add ginger and garlic, then tomatoes and the ground spices. Cook until soft and jammy.
Stir in the peas, then the drained paneer. Cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Finish with kasuri methi, cilantro and lemon. Warm the rotis.
options.tweak: Peas instead of the optional capsicum.

steps: Blend sautéed onion, tomato and cashews into a smooth paste.
Cook the paste with ginger, garlic and the ground spices until the oil separates.
Add water and peas and simmer until the peas are tender.
Add paneer cubes, kasuri methi and a splash of cream. Simmer 2 minutes.
Top with cilantro and serve with rotis.
Start the rice and hard-boil the eggs.
Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in coconut oil. Add onion, ginger, garlic and chili.
Add tomatoes and the ground spices and cook until soft.
Pour in coconut milk, add the peeled eggs and simmer 5 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in a pan with a little garlic and salt on the side.
options.tweak: Garlicky spinach on the side for a veggie.

steps: Simmer the black beans with onion, garlic, cumin and chili powder. Mash a few.
Toss shredded cabbage with lime, cilantro, olive oil and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with beans, slaw, avocado, feta and salsa verde.
Sauté chopped kale with garlic until wilted. Season with lime and salt.
Warm the black beans with cumin and a splash of water.
Fill tortillas with beans, kale, cheese and salsa and roll them up.
Crisp each burrito seam-side down in a hot pan.
Start the rice. Press and cube the tofu and toss it in cornstarch.
Pan-fry the tofu until crisp on all sides.
Steam or roast the broccoli.
Simmer soy sauce, maple, vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, garlic and sriracha until glossy, then toss with the tofu.
Serve over rice with broccoli, sesame seeds and scallions.
Sizzle garlic, rosemary and pepper flakes in olive oil.
Stir in tomato paste, then the chickpeas and broth.
Add the ditalini and simmer until tender and stewy.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Finish with parmesan and olive oil.
options.tweak: Spinach stirred in for a veggie.

steps: Cook the pasta, dropping the peas in for the last minute. Drain and rinse cool.
Whisk lemon, olive oil, dijon, garlic and salt.
Toss pasta and peas with chickpeas, greens, feta, mint and the dressing.
Toast the orzo in olive oil with garlic.
Add broth and simmer, stirring, until creamy.
Stir in the white beans and spinach until warm and wilted.
Finish with lemon zest, lemon juice and parmesan.
options.tweak: White beans stirred in for protein.
